info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Refresh API

params.name: nowHandlingEnabled
params.description: Return \#VALUE for =FDS codes dependent on NOW(). Default is true. For more information on volatile code handling, see Online Assistant https://my.apps.factset.com/oa/pages/16118.

params.name: refreshAutoFilters
params.description: Option to refresh =FDS codes within autofilters.  Codes that are filtered out will not be refreshed, unless this option is set to true.  Default is false.  For more information, see Online Assistant https://my.apps.factset.com/oa/pages/21084#fds

params.name: resizeArrays
params.description: Option to allow automatic array-resizing, which allows you to return a time series of data without manually setting an array.  Default is true.  For more information, see Online Assistant https://my.apps.factset.com/oa/pages/21084#fds

items.docs: Upload a spreadsheet file (in the Open Office XML format) for FactSet to refresh.
